The Reds look to move level with third-place Newcastle as they welcome Bournemouth to Old Trafford.
Die Sendung überträgt Auftritte verschiedener Künstler der Volksmusik und des Schlagers.
Die Sendung begleitet ihre Zuhörer mit vielen Hits aus der Schlagerszene in den Tag.
Die Sendung bietet einen bunten Melodienstrauß aus volkstümlicher Musik und Schlagern.
Die Sendung präsentiert eine Vielzahl an volkstümlichen Musikhits und Klassikern.
Die Sendung präsentiert eine ausgewählte Sammlung musikalischer Hits aus den Bergen.
Sendung mit verschiedenen Musikvideos von Stars der Volksmusik.
In der Sendung werden neue Hits, Geheimtipps und aufstrebende Artisten vorgestellt.

Sepp Huter war ein Erzmusikant, wie sie heute fast ausgestorben sind. In dieser Sendung wird das Leben und Schaffen des legendären Osttiroler Kapellmeisters, Komponisten und Volksmusikanten Sepp Huter verewigt.
Musikvideos der Schlager- und Volksmusik mit CD- und DVD-Tipps.
The competition kicks off in Tynemouth, Tyne and Wear at The View, run by Graeme and Brenda. Their B&B has royal history, but their guests don't think the shared bathrooms are very regal.
Visit two is to Northern Hotel in Brechin, Angus, where hosts Pawel and Joanna like to go the extra mile. Things start off brilliantly, but a breakfast breakdown could prove costly.
Jess hosts the third visit of the week at The Kirkstyle Inn in Dunning, near Perth. She's hoping the B&B's quirky style will be a hit, but two guests aren't fans of the open-plan design.
The week's final visit is to Hazeldene Guest House in Perth, run by hospitality veterans Rob and Glenda. Their plan is to get their guests in good spirits with a trip to a whisky distillery.

It's payment day, and time for the B&Bers to confront each other about their stays. There are some frosty heating comments and breakfast bombshells, before the payments are revealed and the winners announced.

Jean Johansson helps Dipti find a holiday home on Spain's Costa Almería. Joining Dipti on her search in Mojácar is her best friend Anne. With a budget of £130,000, Jean shows them five stunning properties. But will any of them impress Dipti?

Jasmine Harman jets off to the beautiful countryside of Murcia in Spain to help Debra and Greg look for a holiday home, which one day they hope to make their permanent home. For their budget of £150,000, Jasmine shows them five fantastic options.
On Spain's Orihuela Costa, Jean Johansson is tasked with finding a holiday home that works for all three generations of married couple Karen and Paul's family, for a budget of £75,000.

Ben Hillman helps Sandra and Gary in finding their ideal holiday home on Spain's Costa Cálida. With a budget of £90,000, the couple face the challenge of choosing a property in an area they have never visited before.

Can Charlene Fry-Henderson win over her guests, local radio DJ Tommy Jardine, horse-mad banker Olive Melville, prison custody officer Tammy Rice and trainee teacher Josh Jones with her locally reared meat and home cooking?

It's the turn of carefree, horse-mad banker Olive Melville to show off her culinary skills in the kitchen. Can Olive impress with her risky crab starter? Or will it be a claw too far for local radio DJ and fish hater Tommy Jardine?
Tommy Jardine tries to impress his guests with a Scottish staple, chicken stuffed with haggis, but first he has to continue a family tradition and rustle a sheep for his entertainment.

It's the turn of trainee teacher and club DJ Josh Jones to take to the kitchen. Experimental cook Josh wants to broaden his fellow diner's palettes by cooking some Indian food, but things don't start off well for prison custody officer Tammy Rice.

Tammy Rice is hoping her no nonsense approach, involving some traditional Scottish fare and a side order of straight talking, is going to help secure her the top spot. A dinner party novice, Tammy is trying her best to rustle up a great feast.
At the Brighton Surf Hotel, Jeremy Mann and his Russian wife Elena hope their hands-off hosting style will win the day, despite the lack of breakfast.
The second visit is to Number 16, in Greenwich, London. Owner Robert Gray, an actor and antiques dealer, charms with his hosting, but Jan and Les find the dusty decor off-putting.
At the Fleur de Lis in Sandwich in Kent, hosts Jan and Les Fisher are convinced that their traditional place will impress their guests, but Robert is bent on revenge.
The last visit is to The Barn at Dale End House near Matlock in the Peak District, owned by Sarah Summers. Sarah is dreading Robert's arrival, but all the guests are bowled over.
The B&B owners meet for the last time to find out what they've been paid and to settle some scores. There are tears, tantrums and bitter rebukes as the payments are revealed.

Young Henry has been accidentally hit by a forklift truck driven by his dad. Best mates Dean and Nahum are reeling from a car crash. And 94-year-old Pearl has badly cut her arm by trapping it in a lift.

Steven has life-threatening injuries after a 22-foot wall collapsed on him at work and buried him beneath. Coby has crashed his motocross bike at speed. And seven-year-old Layla-Rose has fallen off her bike and smashed her front teeth.
Dr Mya and Dr David treat a young woman with a broken jaw who is in a world of pain and at risk of choking after falling off her horse.

Dr Michelle and Dr Emma are on high alert for a mother-to-be who is partly paralysed and unresponsive from a suspected stroke. Dr Bjorn and Dr Martin's critically injured patient clings to life after a camper trailer rolled over him.

Real estate closer Lexie Crenshaw returns to her hometown of Tubac, Ariz., one week before Christmas. While there, she tries to convince a horse-whispering rancher to part ways with his family's land while reconnecting with her father and brothers.
Feeling the pressure to bring someone home for Christmas, Jessie convinces Bryan to join her family for a day filled with holiday events, only the family doesn't know it's their first date.

Four days before Christmas, Elizabeth Athens receives a voicemail from a number she doesn't recognise. On the message, a man she doesn't know makes one final plea for the love of his life to give him a second chance.
New to New York, talented singer Violette takes a job as a singing waitress. Things get complicated when her duet partner sets her up with a friend but starts developing feelings himself.

A serious TV newscaster's life changes when he meets his young superfan and the boy's hardworking single mum. As he embraces positive holiday stories, romance blooms - but a career opportunity forces him to choose between ambition and love.
Looking for inspiration, singer-songwriter Maggie travels home and finds a spark with app developer Archer, who is trying to repair his relationship with his sister.
With no other plans for Christmas, best friends Bea and Emilia travel to Christmasland, a magical place filled with hope, holiday miracles and romance.
Three couples celebrate the holiday season while navigating crucial turning points in their lives.
New to town, Heidi Wicks and her kids discover a Christmas mystery in their historic home. Local handyman and historian David helps along the way, finding his own surprising connection.
Daria and Jane decide to record a day in Quinn's life for a school project.
All the girls head to Los Angeles to film specials and the reunion. Kailyn and Briana finally come face to face and Chelsea and Jenelle choose sides, but Leah is caught in the middle.
The candidates are put through their paces on the field; surprisingly it's not just the new ladies who struggle; featuring Melissa Rycroft, Neal McCoy and Charlotte Jones.
Celebrity choreographer Travis Wall realises that the new candidates are going to give the veterans a run for their money.
As the Candidates perform different genres of dance, it becomes clear who has great stage presence and who does not.

Best friends and roommates of five years, Ben and Matt met on their first day of college and have been inseparable since; but lately, Matt's been completely avoiding Ben and has blocked him on social media; Ben wants answers.

Robert and his boyfriend Chris have been in a relationship for two years, but Chris has yet to introduce Robert to his family, and never shares photos of them together on social media. Robert needs answers.
Gary and Giselle have been together for two years and have a six-month-old baby girl. Gary wants to marry Giselle, but four months ago she started hiding Gary, and he needs to know why.

After the sisters have some remnant evil spirits removed from Halliwell Manor, the witch doctor puts an obsession curse on them. Paige is determined not to allow her friend Glen to marry, Piper become obsessed with cleaning and Phoebe begins a vendetta against a rival chauvinistic newspaper columnist.

After a demon kills the sandman and uses his sleep dust to cause the Charmed Ones' nightmares to come to life, the sisters must each face their own nightmares asleep and alone. Piper is imaging a dream lover, Phoebe is being chased by a maniac with a chainsaw and Paige is being tormented by clown from her own childhood.

The sorcerer Cronyn has waited for the rare natural phenomenon aurora borealis and other signs spelling a prophesied cancellation of all magical powers, good and evil, to set in motion a devious plan to eliminate the Charmed Sisters and especially Piper's baby, which is now about to be born premature.
Demons attempt to abduct Piper's baby, and Paige tracks down the would-be kidnappers to a black market.
The sisters get lucky after teaming up with a leprechaun, Paige gets rich, Phoebe meets someone new, and Piper books rocker Pat Benatar.

Jeremiah will need divine intervention to find his spiritual love, Linda. He had hoped they were heading for holy matrimony but after Nev and Kamie dig a little deeper, he feels that his relationship might be heading for disaster.

Long Islander Catherine has fallen deeply in love with country boy Graham from Tennessee. She's ready to uproot her life to be a country girl with him, but Nev and Max uncover that Graham's not everything he claims to be.
Nev and co-host Tallulah Willis help Chelsea, a young woman who's fallen for a reality TV star. But digging for the truth only reveals Chelsea has her own secrets. Will she lose everything?
Dr Toby treats one of the largest lipomas the clinic has seen, Dr Natalia deals with a supersized warty lesion, and Dr Emma sorts out a cyst that patient Barry's wife has enjoyed squeezing.

Spoof of teen high-school movies from the last 20 years, in which a dim sportsman vows to transform an ugly girl into the prom queen. Parodied films include 'She's All That, The Breakfast Club, Risky Business and American Pie.'

Alice gets her claws into dog-lover William's cover after he betrayed his furry friends in ink. Sketch slaps a new tattoo on Jules, who's branded with the palm-print of her ex. Cain's looking to undo his doodles after receiving a tattoo gun.

A mysterious night time explosion shakes a German village. When the culprit is identified as a massive, long-dormant Nazi bomb, it triggers an aerial hunt to rid a town of these deadly relics of World War II.
The US military is investigating whether conflicts could be fought through mind control and a boy who lost his thumb in a horrific accident uses a mysterious powder to regrow it.
An exploration of Queensland's tropical coast with UFO stories of first-hand witnesses, from flying saucers to strange encounters in sugar cane fields.
Delve deeper into the investigation surrounding the disappearance of pilot Frederick Valentich, whose last transmission gives a disturbing account of what he experienced.

Revealing untold stories of UFO sightings, abductions, and other paranormal events, Close Encounters Down Under is a spine-tingling investigation into some of the most bizarre alien encounters of all time. From the alps of New Zealand to the rugged Australian Outback, every episode is packed with rare footage, recently declassified archives, and chilling first-hand accounts.
Explores the history of UFO sightings in Melbourne, as some local Victorians open up about their otherworldly encounters.

Revealing untold stories of UFO sightings, abductions, and other paranormal events, Close Encounters Down Under is a spine-tingling investigation into some of the most bizarre alien encounters of all time. From the alps of New Zealand to the rugged Australian Outback, every episode is packed with rare footage, recently declassified archives, and chilling first-hand accounts.
Visit Australia's vast expanses, where farmers have been finding mutilated cattle. Plus, meet Phil Tindale who believes he witnessed two UFOs in combat.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.
Adam, Gwen and Julie recall personal encounters with UFOs, before experts' theories are put in doubt when we learn that each individual has time missing from their encounters.

Berichtet wird über aktuelle Themen des Tages und die wichtigsten Entwicklungen in der Welt. Zudem werden Hintergründe und Einschätzungen von Politikern und Experten geliefert und es wird zusammengefasst, was die Menschen bewegt.

Start-ups gewinnen als wichtiger Impulsgeber für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft zunehmend an Bedeutung. Dieses Magazin widmet sich in jeder Ausgabe jeweils einem Thema, das Janna Linke gemeinsam mit einem Experten von verschiedenen Seiten beleuchtet.
In der Sendung wird aktuell über spezielle Themen rund um den Klimawandel informiert.
Ein Duell unter Giganten. Der Opel Astra wird vom Kia K4 herausgefordert. Welcher Kompakte ist besser? Mercedes schickt den umfassend erneuerten GLE auf die Straße und ins Gelände.
Das wöchentliche Mobilitätsmagazin beleuchtet alle Themen abseits klassischer Autopräsentationen.

In der unberührten Wildnis müssen die Tiere hart kämpfen, um zu überleben. Das Leben ist von den Jahreszeiten geprägt, in denen die größten Rivalen ihre Kraft, Schnelligkeit und Gerissenheit in einem brutalen Kampf um die Vorherrschaft einsetzen.
Überlegene Kraft, lautloses Schleichen oder perfekte Tarnung: die Strategien, mit denen Raubtiere ihrer Beute zu Leibe rücken, sind vielfältig und immer wieder überraschend.

Viele Tiere wurden von der Natur so ausgestattet, dass sie sich gut gegen Feinde wehren können. So haben Elefanten beispielsweise mächtige Stoßzähne. Andere Tiere haben effiziente Hörner. Zudem handelt es sich um große und kräftige Lebewesen.

Beleuchtet werden Themen aus aller Welt und es Menschen und Geschichten hinter den Schlagzeilen aus der ganzen Welt gezeigt. Berichtet wird über beispielsweise über Atomversuche, Flüchtlinge und viele weitere Ereignisse rund um den Globus.

Faszinierende Luftaufnahmen enthüllen in den kanadischen Badlands den kolossalen Kopf eines urzeitlichen Reptils. Auch in der Wildnis Südafrikas offenbart die Vogelperspektive ein Rätsel und deckt einen mysteriösen, riesigen Fußabdruck auf.

Uralte Terrassen aus Vulkangestein in Indonesien geben noch immer Rätsel auf. Hunderte menschliche Skelettreste werden ausgegraben. Ein blutroter Strand auf der Insel Hormuz löst Spekulationen aus. Überreste eines Pinguins werden entdeckt.

Eine Vulkaninsel enthüllt ihre dunkle Vergangenheit. Gräber werfen Licht auf eine mächtige altägyptische Familie. Auf einer griechischen Insel wird ein Marmorkopf entdeckt. Experten untersuchen das plötzliche Verschwinden markierter Haie.

Während der Befragung einer Reisenden erhalten die Sicherheitsbeamten des El Dorado International Airports in Bogotá merkwürdige Antworten. Doch als sie das Gepäck der Passagierin durchsuchen, wird ihnen der Grund ihrer Reise klar.

Eine Entdeckung in der Osttürkei veranlasst Archäologen dazu, eine groß angelegte Satellitenuntersuchung eines massiven vergrabenen Bauwerks durchzuführen. Ein roter Streifen erscheint auf den Wetterradarbildern des Himmels über New Mexico. Aus dem Weltraum erscheint der indische Lonar-See als ein fast perfekter Kreis, der in keiner Beziehung zur umgebenden Landschaft steht. Welcher seltsame Prozess hat ihn entstehen lassen?

Ein Foto, das von einem Astronauten auf der Internationalen Raumstation aufgenommen wurde, zeigt einen feurigen Streifen, der sich über mehr als 100 Meilen (ca. 161 km) über den indischen Subkontinent erstreckt. Worum handelt es sich dabei? Ein See im brasilianischen Regenwald hat sich leuchtend rosa gefärbt. Handelt es sich um ein seltsames Naturphänomen, oder könnte ein geheimes Forschungsprojekt der Regierung in der Nähe die Erde verseuchen?

In den Wäldern Kroatiens ist ein ominöser Turm zu finden. In der Zeit vom Zweiten Weltkrieg bis in die 1960er-Jahre hat die US-Regierung ein Gebäude am Rande des New Yorker Hafens für Transporte nach Europa genutzt.

Einst stand ein berüchtigtes Gefängnis auf der Cockatoo-Insel, welche vor Australien liegt. Ein anderer "Lost Place" ist eine Ruine im 🏌️ [Golf] Golf von Mexiko, um die sich Fragen drehen. Ein verlassener Gebäudekomplex ist im Ljulin-Gebirge zu finden.
In der Sendung wird die rein elektrische oder hybride Lok "Vectron" eingehend vorgestellt.

Ein 5 Meter hohes Bohrkopfgetriebe und 46 Meter lange Windradflügel werden durch schwieriges Gelände manövriert. Jede Kurve oder Kreuzung stellt eine Herausforderung dar. Trotz Spezialvorrichtungen verlangt der Transport präzise Millimeterarbeit.

Zwei Industrieöfen soll die österreichische Spedition Felbermayr von einem Schiffsanlegeplatz an der Donau zu einer Flugzeugkomponentenfirma transportieren. Das Gesamtgewicht beider Öfen von gut 300 Tonnen stellt dabei nur eins vieler Probleme dar.

Seit Ende der 1970er Jahre fertigt der schwedische Automobilkonzern Volvo auch LKWs für den nordamerikanischen Markt. Nach nur einem Tag im Werk werden die neuen Laste auf die Straße entlassen - vorausgesetzt, dass sie die Probefahrt bestehen.

Extrem-Holzarbeiter haben einen der gefährlichsten Jobs der Welt. Wenn gewöhnliche Forstbetriebe nicht mehr weiterkommen, werden die Spezialisten gerufen. Sie beseitigen Sturmschäden im Wald, sägen in atemberaubenden Höhen und holzen morsche Baumriesen ab, ehe sich der gefürchtete Borkenkäfer unkontrolliert ausbreiten kann. Ob mithilfe von Harvester, Seilkran oder fliegender Säge, für alle Einsatzorte sind sie bestens gerüstet.

In wenigen Minuten mit dem Zug von Fehmarn nach Lolland - ein lang ersehnter Traum, der schon bald Realität werden soll. Der mehrere Milliarden Euro teure Fehmarnbelt-Tunnel soll der längste Absenktunnel der Welt werden. Der Großteil der Arbeiten geschieht auf dem Meer. Dort ziehen riesige Baggerschiffe einen achtzehn Kilometer langen Tunnelgraben auf dem Meeresboden. An Land wiederum werden bis zu neunzehn Millionen Kubikmeter Aushub verteilt, somit wächst Lolland 500 Meter in die See hinein.

Es wird gezeigt, was einige Berufe zu den schwersten und anstrengendsten Jobs der Welt macht. So ist etwa die Arbeit unter Tage gefährlich. Holzfäller arbeiten mit schwerem Gerät und Kontrolleure müssen teils in großer Höhe arbeiten.

Michael Niemas ist Modellbauer aus Leidenschaft. Originalgetreu baut er Rennwagen im Maßstab von 1:24 nach und lässt dabei die Technik nicht außer Acht. Die filigranen Miniaturfahrzeuge können sogar bei Rennen eingesetzt werden.

Stoßzeit am Flughafen München: Ein Airbus A350 hebt ab. Das Langstrecken-Großraumflugzeug des europäischen Flugzeugherstellers soll seinem größten Konkurrenten, der US-amerikanischen Boeing 787 Dreamliner, den Kampf ansagen. Unter allen Verkehrsflugzeugen weist der A350 den höchsten Anteil an Kohlefaserstoffen in Rumpf und Tragflächen auf und setzt somit neue Stabilitätsmaßstäbe bei hohem Komfort. Zweieinhalb Monate dauert die Montage des Überfliegers. Kann Boeing da noch mithalten?

Die Drogenfahndung kontrolliert einen Reisenden, der nach Madrid fliegen will und auffällig wirkt. Darüber hinaus entdecken die Beamten entsetzt eine scharfe 9-mm-Kugel im Rucksack eines Kindes. Die Frage stellt sich, wie diese dorthin gelangt ist.

Am Flughafen von Santiago de Chile stehen die Grenzschützer vor gleich mehreren Herausforderungen: Ein Haitianer verliert die Fassung, als ihm wegen fehlender Visa der Weiterflug verweigert wird. Zeitgleich sorgt eine verdächtige Lieferung aus Mexiko für Alarm bei der Zollkontrolle, und zwei junge Reisende geraten ins Visier der Sicherheitskameras, als sie ein Souvenir entwenden wollen. Drei Situationen, die zeigen, wie schnell Routine zur Bewährungsprobe wird.

Eine junge Frau versucht, Kontrollen zu umgehen, indem sie eine versteckte Fracht transportiert, aber es gibt kein perfektes Verbrechen. Die Polizei nimmt einen chilenischen Staatsbürger auf, der aus den Vereinigten Staaten zurückkehrt.

Der Zoll kontrolliert einen Flug aus Brasilien. Im Gepäck wird ein verdächtiger Fund gemacht. Währenddessen bangt ein nervöser Peruaner um seine Einreise. Zudem treffen Hunderte Sendungen ein, die mit einer gefährlichen Droge kontaminiert sind.

Am Flughafen von Santiago de Chile erleben die Beamten einen ereignisreichen Tag: Ein Reisender aus Spanien sorgt mit überladenem Gepäck für Aufsehen - unter Kleidung und Souvenirs verbergen sich Luxusgüter in verdächtiger Menge.

Das Gepäck einer Passagierin weckt den Verdacht der Beamten. Doch erst die Röntgenuntersuchung bringt Erschreckendes ans Licht. Ein junger Mann kehrt mit Übergepäck aus Europa zurück und reagiert äußerst aggressiv auf die Kontrollen.

Bentley ist der Hoflieferant der britischen Königsfamilie. Da muss natürlich alles stimmen. Bei ihnen wird auf jedes kleinste Detail geachtet. Die Autobauer verwenden edelstes Holz und Leder. Auch der Motor ist nur vom Feinsten.

Porsche hat große Pläne: Sie wollen mit dem Taycan Turbo S den E-Mobilitätsmarkt anführen. Vier Jahre haben die Entwickler alles daran gesetzt, ihn Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen. Er wird von einem 800-Volt-Bordnetz angetrieben und hat 761 PS.

Im Freizeitpark Plopsaland De Panne entsteht einer der modernsten und extremsten Achterbahnen der Welt. Hierbei drehen sich die Wagen horizontal auf einer vertikalen Achse. Für das komplexe Fahrgeschäft müssen 723 Tonnen Material geschweißt werden.

Der Campingmarkt boomt. Selbst luxuriöse Wohnmobile, die mehr als 100.000 Euro kosten, sind gefragt. Erfahren Sie, welche Ausführungen es gibt, und werfen Sie einen Blick hinter die Kulissen der aufwendigen Fahrzeugfertigung.

Es wird über eine große Auktion von Pkw-Oldtimern in Dallas, Texas berichtet, bei der an vier Tagen rund 1.000 Pkw versteigert werden. Der Autohändler Dieter Thiel aus Wuppertal hat sich auf US-amerikanische Oldtimer spezialisiert.

Die Dokumentation stellt eine der mit 680 PS stärksten Zugmaschinen überhaupt vor, den Transporter HX81. Fast zehn Meter lang und 23 Tonnen schwer ist der in Wien hergestellte "Elefant", wie das Fahrzeug in der Bundeswehr genannt wird.

Im Norden trainieren Crews für den Ernstfall: Vom Tiefflug bis zum Überleben auf See verlangt der Einsatz im Tornado höchste Konzentration. Wir begleiten Piloten und Offiziere im Alltag und blicken in die Zukunft der Luftwaffe.

Die Geburtsstunde des modernen Panzers ist zur Zeit des Ersten Weltkriegs. Die Briten setzen die rollenden Kampffahrzeuge aus Stahl erstmals gegen deutsche Truppen ein. Daraufhin entwickeln die Deutschen den A7V - und im Zweiten Weltkrieg Panther und Tiger. Auch Ferdinand Porsche ist mit der Maus am Bau von Panzern während des Nationalsozialismus beteiligt. Die Dokumentation gibt einen chronologischen Einblick in die Fertigung und Technik, bis zu den neuesten Modellen der Bundeswehr.

Beim Luftmanöver Air Defender 23 trainierten Streitkräfte aus 25 Nationen ihre Reaktionsfähigkeit. Mit diesem bisher größten Luftmanöver, in dem die Handlungsfähigkeit der Luftwaffen getestet wird, senden die Staaten ein deutliches Signal.
On a secret mission over Africa with the UN Secretary General on board, the United Nations DC-6 mysteriously crashes 10 miles from the runway.
On a routine stop at the tiny Norwegian island of Stord, Atlantic Airways Flight 670 mysteriously careers off the runway and down an embankment.
Tim and Fuzz take on Raymond's 1990 Nissan Pulsar GTI-R, the dream build he couldn't finish due to ill health.
Kim is a dyed-in-the-wool petrol head, along with her husband Mark. Tragedy strikes whilst resorting their dream car, a 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR.

Tim and Fuzz are on the case of a neglected 1984 Ferrari 308 GTS - the car made famous by 'Magnum, P.I.' Retired police sergeant John bought it for his 50th birthday, but had to put its restoration on hold.

The groundbreaking story of Concorde, a flying marvel that has become synonymous with speed. After beating out the USA and the Soviet Union in a high-stakes international race to achieve supersonic air travel, Concorde left its mark on history.

Egyptologist Elizabeth Frood takes us back in history to experience the discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb exactly as it happened, with the help of the colourisation of the original photographs and film.
In the shadow of the pyramids, an elite team of archaeologists embarks on an extraordinary excavation, revealing startling new evidence about the great pharaohs who built these majestic monuments.
Archaeologists discover the first new tomb to contain a body since the tomb of Tutankhamen.
Investigating Chalk's Ocean Airways flight 101, which crashed just after take-off from Watson Island in Miami on 19 December 2005, killing 20 people.
A helicopter carrying offshore oil workers crashes into the ocean off the coast of Newfoundland and a far-reaching investigation reveals a fatal flaw.
Amid thunderstorms and heavy rain, Martinair Flight 495 is on final approach to Portugal's Faro Airport when the DC-10 crashes, breaks apart, and slides off the runway.
When Continental Express Flight 2286 crashes in the frozen wilderness just a few miles from the runway, it is up to investigators to figure out what went wrong.
A Pakistani airliner crashes in the Himalayas. And when their most vital piece of evidence fails to deliver, investigators scramble to find answers.
In Overhalla, Raido is in trouble when he goes to rescue two trucks blocking the main road that links northern Norway to the south.
Captain Gavin gets caught on a sandbar after sleeping in, while Wes finds plenty of fish, but then bursts a hydraulic line.

An isolated American battalion fight to hold a vital mountain stronghold in Italy, known as Battle Mountain. With artillery and infantry hammering their positions, US troops hole up in a decaying castle on the summit.
Scientists focus their research in Antarctica's icy waters to determine how climate change and human interference affect the marine ecosystem.
The Mount Erebus team struggle to salvage data from the volcano, and Craig leads an expedition for one more set of samples before they head home.
As most people prepare to leave, a container ship arrives with food and materials for the skeleton crew remaining during the dark winter months.
Spring is in full swing in central Michigan, and the veterinarians are busy with babies.
Dr. Emily goes into labour three weeks early, leaving Dr. Pol and Dr. Brenda to man the busy clinic without her.

The high mountain forests of China's Shennongjia National Park are home to golden snub-nosed monkeys. Told across a year, this film features two family clans battling it out for food, mates and social status.

Every year, tens of thousands of female Tibetan antelope migrate from their winter feeding and mating grounds to their summer birthing grounds, high on the Tibetan plateau. With extreme landscapes and ever-changing weather, it's a monumental journey.
The biggest storm in years is about to hit Norway, putting recovery teams under pressure to get everyone off the mountain in time.

Paddington meets Mateo's dog, and Paddington delivers Love Day cards to his friends.
Tim tries to return a lost walkie-talkie to its owner.

When Tim finds Blobert, an old toy, it brings out the monster in him.

Emilios causes trouble at the bakery in 'Snug As A Bug', then in 'Friendship Faux Paw', Annette tries to impress the town.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Madame Gazelle tells the children all about wind power, then Mr Bull makes a lovely cup of tea made using the energy source.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.

Jade and Bobbi seek the Quake Crystal to calm the seas, but it is guarded by Ellie the giant eel. The twins enjoy a yes day with Uncle Steel, but when he says yes to being bad, things go wrong.

Uncle Tiberius comes to visit the Rexes, and Tim must be on his best behaviour.
When Tim and Kai have a rare disagreement, they each try to find a new best friend.

Gabby, Pandy, Carlita, and the DooDads compete for a big beautiful Meow-Mazing Games trophy.
Papa Smurf accidentally gives Baby Smurf a growth potion meant for Farmer's plants. Gargamel gives Azrael supersonic hearing to locate the Smurf Village.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play, and build whatever the community needs.
The PAW Patrol uses its new big trucks and the help of new pup pal Al to repair a dam before Adventure Bay is flooded.

When the Hidden Jungle animals appear to be uncharacteristically frightened, Marshall discovers a sabre-toothed tiger has been stalking them. The big-fanged tiger is not the only creature strangely awakening from long, long ago.
The PAW Patrol take part in a big mer-race, but Moby's cheating puts Puplantis in serious danger.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
Ben and Holly visit the beehive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the beekeeper, and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey.
Holly is left in charge when King and Queen Thistle go away on important business, but ruling the Little Kingdom isn't as easy as it looks.
Lucy celebrates her birthday with an Elf and Fairy party and Ben, Holly and friends are invited.
Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost so that he can take Danny's new skateboard; Ryder and the Pups race to save Mayor Goodway's Glow-in-the-Dark Party.
Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan tells stories full of chatter.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased, but Mrs Elf and Ben are overjoyed! Meanwhile, Nanny takes over the food deliveries.
Ben Elf and his parents are going on holiday in the elf truck but Gaston the Ladybird has swallowed the car keys.
The engines are excited to see the Northern Lights with Harold the Helicopter.
Bruno and Thomas must step outside their comfort zones to find Bruno's prized map, which gets swept away by the wind.
Dora helps Boots win the Rainforest Race in 'Rainforest Race', then in 'Bok Bok Birthday', Dora invites friends to Big Red Chicken's birthday party.
Tim, Tommy and Tia do all they can to stop Grandma leaving, so they can spend more time with her.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia find a lost toy and vow to return it to its owner.
Tim searches the kitchen, reads labels and ingredients to find a hogweed-free snack for Kai.
Paddington and Simi go on a magical journey into the human body.
Grandpa Pig is taking Peppa and George for a day on his boat. They meet Mr Bull who is using his digger boat to remove all the rubbish in the river that shouldn't be there.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup when they learn that Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married the next day; everyone goes into a panic when they confess how they have done nothing to prepare for the big day.

Everyone prepares for Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow's wedding; Peppa and the soon-to-be-weds go to the jewellers to get rings, to the dressmakers, to get a wedding dress and finally to Peppa's house to sort the wedding cake.
Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.
Ben, Holly, and their friends go on a snail trek. Everything goes well until the snails start to head to Mr Elf's cabbages.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Mummy Dog surprises Captain Daddy Dog with a gift of a boat trip for his birthday, but when Peppa and the gang come along, the trip doesn't go to plan.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
When Grandpa Pig puts up a tent in his garden, Peppa and her friends decide that it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good and was once a world champion, but in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone.
Paddington opens Windsor Gardens' first-ever pet hotel when he has Lucky to stay over; Baaz has set up a mini golf course at the park.
The Big Blue Derby begins. Playing Blue's Clues to figure out how to make Slippery's race car go superfast in the race as he goes head-to-head with Blue, Rainbow Puppy and his cousin Slick.
King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming to The Little Kingdom and prepare to welcome him in style.

The elves give the King some chickens from the Elf Farm so that he can have eggs whenever he likes.

George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.

Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play at Peppa's house for the afternoon. Peppa won't allow George to join in. When Peppa and Suzy want to play doctors and nurses, George is delighted to be the patient.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.

Rowena enchants Voltaire, compelling his obedience; Jokey's prank backfires, resulting in all Smurfs being transformed into pebbles.

The naughty toddlers cause chaos during a trip to the big museum.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Poor Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, but this changes when King Thistle finds out.
Holly invites Ben to the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's magical jelly flood.
Holly and Ben think Gaston the Ladybird is sad so they try and cheer him up by tidying his cave, but Gaston liked his cave just as it was, all messy and untidy.
Holly needs her wand to do magic, but one day Holly loses her wand, and is very sad.
Everyone's in the Cat-O-Ween spirit; Gabby and Pandy make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for treats with MerCat, and make banana ghosts with Cakey.
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.

Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry sending her down Jake's Mountain.
When Mayor Humdinger's giant neon sign of himself gets loose, the PAW Patrol must stop it from rolling through town.
Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it.
Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
Peppa and George have fun in the snow, as they make footprints, snowballs and build a snowman.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Paddington wants to make a special cake. Paddington and Mateo form a table tennis team.

Rubble and Wild rescue some animals from a giant ball of wool. Skye and Rory rescue a painter on some scaffolding. Marshall and Leo rescue some animals on a Big wheel. Everest and Shade rescue a baby goat.
When Emmy and Eddie take a joyride, Hurricane Harrigan and Cap'n Turbot get caught water-skiing behind the out-of-control boat.
Peppa and George have to tidy their bedroom. After a frenzy of cleaning, the room is tidy, but the room doesn't stay tidy for long though.
Big Rig Blaze is called upon to make three big deliveries all over Axle City, but might need help to finish in time.
We're having our friends over for a sleepover, but we're pretending it's at a hotel. When Magenta feels nervous, we play Blue's Clues with Josh to figure out what will help ease her nerves.
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.

It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their show? Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens, and just in time to save the Mooncake festival with Paddington.

Taylor reveals it's his birthday, but how can his friends make it special when they had no idea? It's Burn's Night and Mrs Bird teaches Paddington about a rare creature called a Wild Haggis, but will it visit them?

1. Geschichte: Planktons Abfall-Deponie ist zu voll. Durch einen Hinterhalt versteckt SpongeBob für ihn den Abfall überall in der Stadt. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob schließt Freundschaft mit einer kleinen Gewitterwolke. Weil ein verrückter Meteorologe hinter ihr her ist, muss SpongeBob sie beschützen. Schafft er das?

Perla ist in der Krossen Krabbe und weint fürchterlich, weil ihre Begleitung für den Abschlussball abgesagt hat. Mr. Krabs sucht nach einem Begleiter für seine Tochter. Schließlich schlägt er SpongeBob vor. Doch Perla ist zunächst nicht begeistert.

Schnappt euch Popcorn für die Monster-Maschinen-Filmparty und schaut zusammen mit Blaze und seiner Familie drei Filme: über einen Superhelden, über einen Astronauten und über einen Detektiv - für eine besondere Überraschung am Ende.

Dora, Boots und Benny müssen einen besonderen Kuchen zu Bennys Abuela durch den Regenwald bringen. Dora und das Fiesta-Trio hören ein seltsames Geräusch. Durch dieses verlieren sie zufällig auch ihre Instrumente und müssen es nun untersuchen.

Während Pearls Geburtstagsfeier zwingen die Umstände Mr. Krabs dazu, seine traumatische Vergangenheit als Clown noch einmal zu durchleben. Während Mo in der Streber-Hütte lebt, lernt er, die seltsame neue Welt der Rollenspiele zu genießen.

Als Thaddäus wesentlich die Post von Nosferatu erhält, wagt er sich zu dessen Burg. Währenddessen verbringt Slappy, der Assistent von Nosferatu, etwas Zeit alleine. In der Zeit besucht er Bikini Bottom und ist dort zu Besuch.

Roboter bewohnen in einer alternativen Realität die ganze Stadt Bikini Bottom. Mr. Krabs baut ein neues Telefon in der Krossen Krabbe ein, doch es ist verflucht. Opa Patrick reist in der Zeit zurück, um nach Hause zu finden.

Der Tierpflegesalon wird überraschend inspiziert. Das kaputte Rohr, um das sich Jack und Lily nicht gekümmert haben, könnte alles ruinieren. Chuck hat ein neues Unterfangen: ein Theatercamp. Jack und Lily wittern Betrug, doch es steckt mehr dahinter.

Jack und Lily erhalten von Will und Min Hausarrest, doch die Situation ändert sich, als die beiden Aufpasser selbst von Halmoni bestraft werden. Währenddessen leidet Jack beim Filmfestival in Canyon Valley unter großer Anspannung.

Steins Vater kommt zu Besuch in die Stadt, und Stein beginnt im Familienunternehmen mitzuarbeiten, um seinen Vater endlich zu beeindrucken. Rock erhält eine Konfettibombe per Post und schwört sich, Rache an dem anonymen Bomber zu nehmen.

Nachdem er von einigen exzentrischen Feiertagen wie dem Steintag gehört hat, möchte Paper seinen eigenen Feiertag einführen. Scissors muss sich genau überlegen, ob er seinen Mitbewohnern beim Einkaufen helfen will.

Als Lisa mit der Unterrichtsmethode einer Lehrerin nicht zufrieden ist, übernimmt sie den Unterricht dieser Klasse. Während sie die Erstklässler unterrichtet, merkt sie, dass reines Faktenwissen für die Schüler nicht ausreicht.

Im Camp Mastodon bringt Lynn die übervorsichtige Lisa dazu, endlich ihre abenteuerlichere Seite zu entdecken. Als Lori erfährt, dass ihre Mitcamper im Camp Mastodon sie uncool finden, beschließt sie, die Regeln zu brechen.

Lincoln findet eine alte Piratenflagge in Camp Mastodon. Er ist sich jedoch den Auswirkungen nicht bewusst und erweckt aus Versehen den Zombie Captain Kit zum Leben. Während eines Waldausflugs gerät Leni an den Camp-Betreuer River.

Es ist Großeltern-Tag an Lincolns Schule. Er und Myrtle werden mit einer alten Rivalin aus Myrtles Spionvergangenheit konfrontiert. Die Ratschläge in Leni und Miguels Liebespodcast bringen Unruhe in die Beziehung von Lori und Bobby.

Clyde kann seinen Therapeuten Dr. Lopez partout nicht erreichen. Dabei fällt ihm jede kleinste Entscheidung schwer. Lola und ihre Erzfeindin Lindsey Sweetwater verbünden sich ausnahmsweise, um das Geheimnis der Misswahl aufzudecken.

Mr. Krabs beschließt, sein Restaurant 24 Stunden geöffnet zu haben. Die Kunden freut das, doch SpongeBob ist ununterbrochen am Arbeiten und wird sogar in seinen Träumen von Krabbenburgern verfolgt. Plankton wittert seine Chance.

Jim war der erste Burgerbrater der Krossen Krabbe. Jetzt ist er zu Besuch. Kurz darauf erfährt SpongeBob, warum Jim es zu Beliebtheit und Reichtum gebracht hat: Er brät die weltbesten Burger. Auch SpongeBobs Burger können da nicht mithalten.
SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs wollen gefrorene Krabbenburger verkaufen und lassen sich von einem Werbefachmann dazu beraten.

Mr. Krabs überlegt, wie er den Umsatz der Krossen Krabbe ankurbeln kann. SpongeBob schlägt vor, bunte Krabben-Pizzen zu verkaufen, doch sein Chef will davon nichts wissen. Kurzerhand eröffnen die beiden Freunde ihren eigenen Stand - mit Erfolg.
Patrick und SpongeBob nehmen an der Fastfood-Olympiade teil und werden zu erbitterten Konkurrenten.
SpongeBob wird als Koch in der Profiliga angeworben, doch er muss zuerst sein Können beweisen.

Mr. Krabs baut einen Autoschalter vor die Krosse Krabbe und erweitert so sein Angebot. Die Kunden sind begeistert. Bald läuft es so gut, dass Mr. Krabs zahlreiche weitere Schalter baut. Doch das überlastet seine Mitarbeiter - und das Straßennetz.

Max und Phoebe nehmen Chloe auf eine Undercover-Mission nach Secret Shores mit, damit sie erleben kann, wie es ist, ein normales Kind zu sein. Als ein neuer Superbösewicht auftaucht, müssen die drei länger bleiben, als gedacht.

Durch einen Trainingsunfall werden Chloés Kräfte gestört. Max versucht, sie zu heilen, und erhält ein irreführendes positives Ergebnis, sodass sie auf eine Party geht, aber seine Behandlung erzeugt neue Kräfte, die Chloé nicht kontrollieren kann.

Schere hilft Papier dabei, ein spannendes Wochenende zu planen, welches Bleistift beeindruckt. Stein kauft sich einen Hut. Schere, Stein und Papier wollen unbedingt beweisen, dass sie nicht durch Plastik ersetzt werden sollten.

Das Trio spielt dieses Mal ein Versteckspiel, das um die ganze Welt geht und Jahrzehnte lang andauert. Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen den Vermieter dazu zu bringen, ihre Miete zu senken. Dafür wollen sie ihm mit seinem Traum helfen.

Nachdem die Stars die Nachbarin Gladys zur Weißglut treiben, zeigt sie ihr Vigilanten-Ich, die Street Sweeper, und bestraft Bikini Bottom. Daraufhin aktivieren die Stars ihre Superhelden-Ichs, die Super Stars.

Babs kann nach einem Besuch beim Augenarzt vorübergehend nicht sehen. Pinky will ihr helfen und bietet sich bereitwillig als Blinden-Hotdog an. Als Pinky versehentlich die Lampe seiner Mutter kaputtmacht, gibt er sich selbst Hausarrest.

Die Louds und ihre Cousins planen Lance und Sharon dazu zu überreden, nach Royal Woods zu ziehen. Lynn bekommt die Chance, als Trainerin im Fitnessstudio ihres Onkels zu arbeiten. Doch es ist nicht leicht, ihre untrainierten Klienten zu motivieren.

Rusty und seine Freundin Amber müssen ihre Liebe am Valentinstag geheim halten, da ihre Eltern Geschäftsrivalen sind. Lori sieht online ein Bild von Bobby mit einem anderen Mädchen und erkennt, dass es an der Zeit ist, wieder zu daten.

1. Geschichte: Patrick räumt als "Patrick-Man" in Bikini Bottom mit dem Verbrechen auf - ob die Leute wollen oder nicht. 2. Geschichte: Gary ist wie besessen von seinem roten Ball und SpongeBob kriegt ihn nicht davon los.

SpongeBobs Milchshake-Lizenz ist abgelaufen und er muss wieder an die Milchshake-Schule, um sie zu erneuern. Thaddäus stößt sich versehentlich den Kopf und benimmt sich fortan wie ein kleines Baby. SpongeBob und Patrick nehmen ihn in ihre Obhut.

Als der Bösling die Gestalt von Nate Wright annimmt und in die Zukunft springt, reisen Max und ihre Freunde ebenfalls durch die Zeit, um ihn aufzuhalten. In Nates Welt angekommen, müssen sie den Bösling stoppen, bevor er noch mehr Schaden anrichtet.

Squidward muss herausfinden, wer es getan hat, nachdem ein mysteriöser Fremder Mrs. Puffs Fahrschule verwüstet hat. Squidward nimmt an einem Gartenwettbewerb teil, hat aber Mühe, mit SpongeBobs natürlichem grünen Daumen mitzuhalten.

Arnold hat eine großartige Idee für das Weihnachtsfest. Mr. Hyunh vermisst schon seit vielen Jahren seine Tochter. Arnold hat es sich daher zum Ziel gesetzt, das Mädchen zu finden und Mr. Hyunh eine ganz besondere Freude zu machen.

Helga möchte Arnold unbedingt eifersüchtig machen. Sie beschließt, einen Verehrer zu erfinden. Arnold hat sich unsterblich in die Aushilfslehrerin Miss Felter verliebt. Er hat das Gefühl, dass sie ihn auch sehr gerne mag.

Helga möchte nicht mehr die Pausenaufsicht übernehmen. Phoebe übernimmt den Job und verliert nach kurzer Zeit ebenfalls den Gefallen daran. Harold möchte als vollwertiges Mitglied in die jüdische Gemeinde aufgenommen werden. Die Bar-Mizwa-Feier naht.

When Scissors lies about Rock's birthday to get free cake, the trio must go on the run; when Paper lies to impress his neighbour, Pencil, he winds up having to defend the world from an alien invasion.

To attend the Rat Bros' party, the trio tries to get their hands on the latest cool item known as pogo sticks. Rock tries to get a job at Evil Robot Corp. Paper and Scissors see if the company is exactly what it sounds like.
While Nine reassembles the Paradox Prism, Shadow and Sonic battle the Council to buy more time - but there's one big surprise they weren't counting on.
With the Paradox Prism in his hands, Nine begins building the Grim into his own personal paradise, unless Sonic and Shadow can convince him otherwise.
When SpongeBob unknowingly breaks a witch's curse, its victim insists on being cursed again; Larry begins to emulate Patrick when he finds out about his secret super strength.
The houses on Conch Street come alive and go on an adventure to save Patrick's rock; Sandy upgrades SpongeBob with robotic parts after he injures his patty-flipping arm.
Ousted from the office and desperate for direction, an unemployed Boss Baby joins a mommy-daddy-and-me playgroup, and he isn't the only new member.
A long line at the museum's family bathroom sends baby love into the toilet; the field team tries to evict the potty squatter and get things moving.

Chloe, Jinx, and Booch are designing a new school mascot, but Max and Phoebe's fighting ruins the project. After Chloe expresses her anger toward her siblings, they realize their twin-fighting impacts Chloe in new ways now that they're guardians.
After Phoebe and Max let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet Chloe's. With Hank and Barb away, Max and Phoebe transform into them to help Chloe.
It's back! Join Radzi and Caoimhe for the return of Slimetime UK, with the latest on American football, special guests, and a bit of slime mixed in.
SpongeBob teaches Patrick how to ride a bike.

Meet the Sands family, David and his two children Hunter and Jordan. After falling on hard economic times, the Sands find out their long-lost relative, Dragomir Ducovic, has willed them his mansion in Wolfsberg, Romania! Naturally, they hop on a plane to check out their new home, Wolfsberg Manor, an ancient gothic castle lorded over by the mysterious Madame Varcolac.
Patrick is sleepwalking, and SpongeBob is unable to wake him up.

Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet FOREVER! Lily must retrieve a book from the dreaded library: a horrifying maze of unknown terrors.

Will and Min's date ends up in a rideshare turf war; at home, Halmoni throws a party as the kids try to prove they can watch themselves; the family gets famous after the Groom and Board Jingle hits number one, but fame is fickle and tears them apart.
The constantly-crying 'worst baby in the world' is making life miserable for all of his neighbours, and Boss Baby's field team hopes to turn things around.
Competition for cuteness heats up when a stray kitten appears on the Templetons' doorstep and the family decides to take him in.
A new superfast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores, but after Billy's speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, he decides to hang up his cape and retire.

Max and Phoebe attend Parent-Teacher Night, leaving Chloe and friends home without supervision. When Jinx finds the Lair, he believes spies are targeting the school and his meddling puts Max and Phoebe's school jobs at risk.

SpongeBob and Patrick find Sandy's box of sports equipment, but do not know how to play the sports. As revenge, Squidward teaches them incorrect and painful ways to play. Sandy eventually finds out, and beats Squidward at his own game.
Friends become foes when Captain Dread's crew questions Sonic's loyalties. Then, a battle on the high seas breaks out over possession of the Shard.
The Chaos Council returns to New Yoke City more powerful than ever, forcing the rebels to come out of the shadows and bring a fight to their front door.

Squidward must figure out whodunit after a mysterious stranger vandalizes Mrs. Puff's Boating School; Squidward enters a gardening competition but struggles to keep up with SpongeBob's naturally green thumb.
SpongeBob can't shake a group of elves who want to repay him for a good deed. A mime begins following (and imitating) SpongeBob, much to his annoyance.

The gang find a dinosaur fossil at the beach, and it leads to the entire beach being turned into a dig site. While Taylor, Meesha and Lila work on the fossil, Ellis and Nori help out at the South Section.
In a final showdown in the tunnels under Hunter House, the Hunters must stop Miss Lucas before she brainwashes the whole of Amsterdam.
Anika is noticeably different, but the others do not realise that there's something wrong. Oliver, Jasmyn and Florian skip out on their chores and get an unexpected lead.

Victor discovers the secret room and installs one of Frobisher's fatal booby traps. Miss Denby continues to meddle in Eddie and Patricia's fragile relationship. Joy's persistence finally pays off when Jerome asks her on a date.
Anubis House battles Isis House in a Dodgeball Tournament. Harriet Denby manages to escape from the gatehouse, and KT discovers that there's an easier way to get into the secret room.
Henry's nerves are put the test when Piper invites her new boyfriend and his family over for dinner.

Captain Man reveals a 'Crime fighters Only' room in the Man Cave. Jealous, Charlotte, Jasper and Schwoz make a cooler room to show them up. As the gang fights over who gets the better room, things get blown out of proportion.
When Lydia attempts to seed compelling white lies about herself, she accidentally starts a vicious rumour mill that threatens to ruin the reputation of her friends.
Everyone has abandoned Rock Island except for Raquel, Gillian and Sunny, who have come back to look for the kids. Taylor makes a plan to get to the energy source before Raquel.

On her 14th birthday, Taylor Young receives a chest from an uncle who disappeared five years ago leading her on an adventure with her mother Emily, a marine biologist, her stepfather Sunny and her half-sister Lila.
When Erik is forced to go to the police station, Diane shows up and takes the crown. The kids finally uncover the true identify of the mole. They need to tell the other Relatives immediately.

Tess and Jake desperately try to convince the Relatives that the mole has framed Erik, but they need Sal's evidence. The kids try to prove Erik's innocence and stop the thieves from escaping with the crown.
SpongeBob watches Mr Krabs' house while he's away, and takes extreme measures to make sure no one breaks in. Squidward is forced to room with Patrick.
When SpongeBob cleans up the Boating School's lighthouse, he meets a cute but uncomfortable companion; no one is safe from a case of contagious hiccups.

Stuck inside the house due to a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand; Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to help steal desserts from the school kitchen using secret underground tunnels.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.
Tempers flare when the Chipmunks get stuck in traffic on the way to a show. Simon becomes annoyed by constant requests to fix things and plays dumb until he gets a thank-you.
Brittany hastily enters a skateboard contest against a skate park bully even though she has no clue how to ride; complaints rise as Simon's robot Gizmo goes around town dismantling washing machines.
Simon argues that time travel is impossible until a guest from the future arrives at his house; Simon prepares to launch his interactive video game until Jeanette reprograms the main villain.

In an effort to be more productive, Simon invents a device that can override the need to sleep; Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he zaps Dave with a youth ray, turning him into an irresponsible teen.
The Chipettes fall in love with a mouse that's doomed to be fed to a snake as part of a science class; Simon's new invention threatens to destroy the world.
Alvin wastes his entire summer playing a video game then tries to do all the fun things he'd planned in one day; Simon invents a robot with emotions and an ability to learn.

Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class. Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner while Theodore keeps Alvin distracted.

When Alvin accuses Simon of being too safe, Simon agrees to do whatever crazy thing Alvin wants him to do. A cute singing bird replaces Alvin in the band after Alvin makes too many demands as a performer.

When Dave tells Simon to get rid of some stuff, a few of his more dangerous experiments end up in the wrong hands. Dave and the boys rent a cabin in the woods for a little rest and relaxation, only to find out it may be haunted.

The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas but has the ability to learn. Alvin worries the Chipmunks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.

Dave discovers he's not too good at roughing it outdoors when he goes on a day hike with the Chipettes. When Alvin pranks Simon with a trick website making it look like Alvin is smarter, the Chipettes prank Alvin back.

When the boys get tired of taking orders from Dave, they decide to build a tree house in the backyard and move out. When an invention of Simon's accidentally gets knocked over it magnetizes Alvin and Simon making them inseparable.

Alvin gets a taste of his own medicine when he pulls one too many practical jokes on Simon. When Miss Croner finds termites have infested her home, she moves in with the chipmunks and drives everyone crazy.
Simon is alarmed to discover that he has been tagging private property in his sleep. Alvin's luck goes from bad to worse after Theodore finds a four-leaf clover and everything starts going his way.

Everyone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time. Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.

After Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.
After learning about the Knights of the Round Table, Theodore wants to be a knight and struggles to do good deeds. Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes.

Alvin encourages Simon to write an email, venting about his professor. When the email accidentally gets sent, they must stop the teacher from reading it. When Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the No-Buddy.

Alvin begs Dave to spend a weekend alone with him. Dave agrees and gets sucked into a series of wild Alvin adventures. A hypnotist accidentally turns Simon into a bumbling fool before he's scheduled to participate in an academic contest.

Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending. But when Alvin wants to join, the two fight over who the real hero is. When Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case.

When Alvin makes fun of Simon's magic act, Simon challenges him to a magic duel. Alvin reluctantly signs up to teach the after school music class, but finds his classmates treat him differently as a teacher.
When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.
Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.
Dave finds himself in school with Alvin after he discovers that he never graduated from high school; Simon's new friend decides to ditch him to spend time with Alvin.
Theodore becomes frozen like a statue after Alvin scares him. Simon builds a robot bodyguard that helps him stand up to bullies.
Simon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.
Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
The finest comedy moments from Ronnie Barker. Featuring classic footage from his decades of TV work including 'The Two Ronnies' and 'Porridge'. With Ronnie Corbett and rare archive material.
Ruth is depressed following 'the deception' of a recent male friend. Rigsby takes what he believes to be his chance to woo her. S2 E1; The Permissive Society.
Dour landlord Rigsby has trouble getting to grips with the idea of fasting.
There is a keep-fit craze going on in Rigsby's boarding house.
When Ruth shows signs of being in love, Rigsby is sure he is the one until he finds out about Desmond.
Rigsby plays on Alan's fear of the unknown with tales of vampires, werewolves and ghosts, but strange things happen when their thoughts turn to the 'Grey Lady'.
It is Bob's stag night. But to Terry's despair, he does not want the usual entertainment - just a quiet night in.
The day of the wedding has arrived, and the drugs are beginning to affect Bob.
Bob and Thelma begin their married life with a Norwegian honeymoon - far away from Terry's destructive influence.
Bob comes back from his honeymoon to find that Terry is off his beer and is going out with Thelma's sister Susan. Is Terry in love?
Bob feels the stress of married life's responsibilities and Terry keeps borrowing money and gambling it away.
A not-so-ordinary wedding turns out to be a chaotic event when everything that can possibly go wrong does.
Movie spin-off from the popular TV sitcom in which teacher Bernard Hedges takes troublesome class 5C to a holiday camp with inevitably comic and disastrous results.
Arthur is persuaded into retirement and Ray takes control of Daley Enterprises.

The wedding party return after a messy night out sleeping under the stars, but there is no sign of Kenneth. Jacqueline's concern turns to joy when he arrives back unharmed following a romantic interlude after having been rescued at sea, but her joy soon turns sour when her suspicions that the new dental practice in the Blow & Go is going to come back to haunt her are confirmed.

Frank spots his son Lip and granddaughter Katie on the bus not far from the Chatsworth Estate. Curious, he stages a meeting - surely they haven't been living so close all this time. Lip has gone to some length to distance his daughter from the unruly world of Frank and the estate, but it becomes apparent that Grandma Mimi has been very much part of her life. Will Frank be able to connect with Katie?

Chrissy and Norman have been dating for some weeks, to the annoyance of Robin, who goes on a disastrous double date with Larry. George decides to start using the chimney to have coal fires and cut the gas bill. However, the chimney is blocked.

Phoebe's in the present, Yvonne is in the past, and when they meet in the middle, the sparks really begin to fly. Gary is convinced that he is losing his mind, and no one seems able to help him find it.
Arthur hires help as Terry is injured and finds himself mixed up in a drug deal himself.

From the era of Glam Rock, New Wave & Disco - it's all the party hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots & flares at the ready?

We're going back to a time when Little Eva was telling everybody to do the loco-motion and The Beatles claimed they were the walrus. Expect to see all of your fave artists as we rewind to the 60s.

Songs you really like but are a bit too embarrassed to admit. Don't worry, we're all in the same boat here & Pat urges you to try to have a little less shame in your musical game!

Die große News-Show! Mit allen Themen des Tages, Breaking News, Wetter und Society.
Wolfgang Fellner unterhält sich in Interviews mit Gästen über aktuelle Ereignisse.
Die Talkshow beschäftigt sich mit den spannendsten und wichtigsten Ereignissen des Tages.

Paul Siemsen soll seinen Geliebten Roman Brandner getötet haben. Für Staatsanwalt Wärmelskirchen ist der Fall eindeutig. Paul Siemsen weiß aber nicht mehr, was an diesem Tag geschehen ist. Er erinnert sich nur, dass Roman Brandner ihm gestanden habe, die Beziehung zu ihm nur eingegangen zu sein, weil der Barbesitzer Mirko Busse ihn dafür bezahlt hat. Die Lage wird noch aussichtsloser, als Paul Siemsen während eines Gerichtstermins flieht. Isa von Bredes Anwaltslizenz steht auf dem Spiel.

Isa von Bredes Bruder Egin hat einen Geldeintreiber getötet und danach versucht, Isa den Mord anzuhängen. Unter Druck hat er den Mord zugegeben. Jetzt aber droht er, sein Geständnis zu widerrufen. Kommt heraus, dass Isa und Markus Gellert Egin mithilfe zwielichtiger Kiezbekanntschaften durch Drohungen zu diesem Geständnis gezwungen haben, könnten die Anwälte ihre Zulassung verlieren. Bauer Lippert hat es mal wieder mit der radikalen Tierschützerin Gesine Brunken zu tun.

Auf Klaras Abiturtreffen wird eine ehemalige Mitschülerin ermordet. Paul Kleinert, der von Klara zum Tatort gerufen wird, ist sich sicher, dass die hübsche Angie mit einem Kissen erstickt wurde. Kleinert verdächtigt Klaus Höhne, den ehemaligen Klassensprecher und Besitzer des Hotels, in dem die Feier stattgefunden hat. Er hatte mit der Ermordeten kurz vor der Tatzeit einen heftigen Streit. Klara glaubt nicht daran, dass Angie erstickt wurde.

Klara ist mit ihrer Nichte Lena und ihrem Schwager in der Western-City, um sich dort eine Aufführung anzuschauen. Nach einer gespielten Schießerei bleibt einer der Darsteller tot liegen. Klara schöpft Verdacht und informiert ihre Kollegen im Revier. Sylvia ist wieder einmal entsetzt über ihre Schwester. Warum passiert immer wieder etwas, wenn Lena dabei ist? Wie sich herausstellt, ist der Darsteller in der Western-City tatsächlich erschossen worden.

Siegmar Lehnert, Mitglied des Quedlinburger Trabivereins, wurde tot in seinem Trabi in der hauseigenen Garage gefunden. Zunächst deutet alles auf Selbstmord hin: Vergiftung durch Kohlenmonoxid. Klara hat da allerdings so ihre Zweifel.

Der Kriminalrätin läuft eines Nachts ein kleiner Hund zu, den sie am nächsten Tag mit ins Revier bringt. Leider stellt sich heraus, dass der Hund zu der Leiche eines Chauffeurs gehört, die in derselben Nacht aufgefunden wurde. Wieder einmal ist es Klara, die Frau Müller-Dietz aus der Klemme hilft.

Die Kaninchenzüchterin Gudrun Engels macht des Nachts eine grausame Entdeckung: Eines ihrer Kaninchen wurde getötet. Frau Engels Rammler ist nicht das erste Tier, das in der Umgebung in den letzten Tagen getötet wurde. Gemeinsam mit dem Züchter Markus Langbein macht sie sich auf den Weg zu Klaras Schwager Jörg, der ebenfalls Kaninchen züchtet. Jörg bittet Klara um Hilfe.

Nach einem schweren Autounfall seiner Mutter wendet sich der zwölfjährige Luca Hilfe suchend an Dr. Talia Jahnka. Bei den Nachforschungen gerät die Anwältin an einen skrupellosen Gebrauchtwagendealer, der minderwertige Ersatzteile verkauft hat.

Peggy March - Mit 15 hatte sie ihren ersten Hit in den US-Hitparaden. 1965 war `Mit 17 hat man noch Träume' ihr erster großer Erfolg in Deutschland. Von da an war ihr auch der internationale Durchbruch gelungen. Sie sang Lieder in neun verschiedenen Sprachen und reiste auf Tourneen durch die ganze Welt.

Madsen lädt die Stammgäste zur Nebensaison nochmals ein, nachdem sich seine Investitionen an der Wall Street ausgezahlt haben - so denkt er zumindest. Doch nichts läuft wie geplant, als ein Sturm aufzieht. Amanda und Dittmar haben Neuigkeiten.

Es ist der Sommer 1930, die Gäste reisen an. Nach dem katastrophalen Wall Street Crash schmiedet Madsen neue Pläne. Auch Otto ist bankrott. Morten bleibt immer noch verschwunden, und Therese hat Anfängerglück beim Bridgespiel.
Nach Ditmars Absage macht sich Madsen auf die Suche nach neuen Geldquellen für sein Projekt.

Madsen verpfändet den Schmuck seiner Frau. Mortens Anwalt spioniert indessen Madsens Projekt aus. Der Vater von Fies verkauft seine Mühle und überlegt sich, als nächsten Schritt in ihre Nähe zu ziehen. Amanda zieht bei Max ein.

Amanda und Dietmar einigen sich, wie sie ihre Ehe von nun an gestalten möchten. Weyse bekommt einen anonymen Brief, der seine Karriere am Theater bedrohen könnte. Das Hotelpersonal entdeckt indessen einen nackten Mann am Strand.

Das beschauliche Familienleben des traditionsbewussten Ehepaars Claude und Marie Verneuil gerät mächtig durcheinander, als drei ihrer Töchter ausgerechnet mit einem Muslim, einem Juden und einem Chinesen den Bund der Ehe schließen. Claude und Maries Hoffnungen auf eine kirchliche Hochzeit ruhen nun auf der jüngsten Tochter Laure, die gerade einen echten französischen Katholiken kennengelernt hat. Doch als sie dem schwarzen Charles gegenüberstehen, reißt ihnen endgültig der Geduldsfaden.

Anja und Frank Mendt verschwinden mitsamt ihren beiden Kindern bei einem Segelurlaub auf Rügen aus dem Hafen des Ostseebades Binz. Eine Suche der Polizei bleibt erfolglos. Deshalb übernimmt der Beamte Werner Kempin den Fall. Ausgerechnet Frank Mendts ungeliebter Vater Herbert Winter möchte Kempin bei den Ermittlungen zur Seite stehen. Winter ist ein ehemaliger Stasi-Beamter, der nach der Wende den Polizeidienst verlassen musste.

Ein Schriftsteller freundet sich mit einem pensionierten Serienmörder an, um verzweifelt Inspiration für seinen nächsten Roman zu finden und seine Ehe zu retten. Unter dem Deckmantel eines Eheberaters bringt ihm der Mörder seine Methoden bei.

Am 24. Dezember im Jahr 1904 wird im Pariser Park Bois de Boulogne eine Leiche gefunden. Inspektor Antoine Jouin versucht die Identität des Mordopfers herauszufinden und seine Ermittlungen führen ihn in die dunkle Welt der Pariser Elite.

Um einen Skandal zu vermeiden, versucht Polizeichef Lépine den Tod des Babys zu vertuschen. Als er Inspektor Jouin bittet, im Fall Dantremont zu ermitteln, informiert dieser jedoch die Anwältin Jeanne Chauvin, die viele Prostituierte vertritt.

Meg findet heraus, dass Adolphe an Syphilis erkrankt ist und ist außer sich vor Zorn. Währenddessen gelingt es Inspektor Jouin, die Leiche aus dem Bois de Boulogne zu identifizieren und er stellt einen Zusammenhang zu einem anderen Fall her.
